Crosscheck

Accounting strain against the gap to analyst estimates, for 609 companies.

Ticker▲ Company▲ Sector▲ ShortfallScore▲ Tests▲ Gap (pp)▲ Reading▲ Cap (US$bn)▲

Notes

Shortfall scores each company against six tests of accounting quality and ranks it within its sector; 100 is the most strained. Tests is how many of the six could be run at all. Gap is the distance between the price and where analyst estimates sit, in percentage points, so a positive number means the price is behind the estimates. The two measures are close to independent across these companies, which is why the corners are worth reading: neither site can tell you what the other one says. Built from Shortfall (640 companies) and Consensus Drift (1216), 09 September 2026. General information, not advice.
